title: 第9章 九姨娘第10章 众生平等器
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
“啊？八姐，怎么这么问？”
叶凡盯着沈慕戎。
四目相对！
沈慕戎一脸严肃：“若小凡你无心争霸，那我们姐妹便会镇守边疆，守护大夏，是你背后最坚韧的盾牌！”
“若小凡想问鼎天下，我们姐妹便是你手里最锋利的一剑，为你扫清一切障碍！”
叶凡心中感动。
难怪前世的自己能当二十多年纨绔，十位姐姐在为他负重前行啊！
要不是秦风伪造的那一封造反密信，八姐也不会被褫夺军权，更不会惨死！
“八姐，你对我太好了！”
叶凡长叹一口气：“可惜你是我亲姐姐，否则，我真想把你娶回家！”
“现在，我长大了，换我保护你！”
“哦？呵呵~”
沈慕戎的美眸深处，闪过一抹意动：“一言为定！”
叶凡以为沈慕戎说的是保护她这件事，拍了拍胸脯：“放心，有挂！”
沈慕戎一脸奇怪：“小凡，你说什么，我怎么听不不懂啊？”
“没事。”
叶凡微笑的摇头：“不过，我确实不想当皇帝！”
沈慕戎看着他：“哦？一人之下，万人之上的权利，你不想要吗？”
叶凡耸了耸肩：“当皇帝多累啊？一辈子被囚禁在皇宫大内。”
“真到了那一步，扶持一个皇帝，自己在幕后操控不好吗？”

八姐震惊的抬起头，像是不认识叶凡一样！
……
与此同时，大夏龙都，一处奢华的府邸深处。
大夏宰相王国忠来到一个房间外，敲了七下房门，‘吱呀’一声门开了。
两名绝色少女推开房门，打着哑语手势，她们是聋哑人，不会说话也听不见，更不认识字，可以守住一切秘密！
王国忠打了一个手势后。
两个聋哑少女让开一条路。
王国忠走进去，对着一个屏风单膝跪地：“殿下！皇帝大怒，李承乾被废！”
“叶凡全身而退，沈慕戎回龙都了！”
屏风后面传来一个阴柔的声音：“我已经知道了！”
王国忠心中暗暗吃惊，他第一时间离开皇宫，直奔此地而来，殿下居然提前知道一切？难道陛下身边也有殿下的人？
“沈慕戎回来的很匆忙，坐的是闪电隼，她是一个人回来的！”
content_en:
"Ah? Eighth sister, why do you ask that?"
Ye Fan stared at Shen Murong.
Eye to eye!
Shen Murong looked serious: "If Xiaofan has no intention of fighting for hegemony, then our sisters will guard the border and protect Daxia, and we will be the toughest shield behind you!"
"If Xiaofan wants to conquer the world, our sisters will be the sharpest sword in your hand, clearing all obstacles for you!"
Ye Fan was moved in his heart.
No wonder he was a playboy in his previous life for more than twenty years, and his ten sisters were carrying the burden for him!
If it hadn't been for the secret letter of rebellion forged by Qin Feng, the Eighth Sister would not have been deprived of military power, let alone die tragically!
"Eighth sister, you are so good to me!"
Ye Fan sighed: "It's a pity that you are my biological sister, otherwise, I really want to marry you home!"
"Now that I have grown up, I will protect you!"
"Oh? Haha~"
Deep in Shen Murong's beautiful eyes, a flash of intention flashed: "It's a deal!"
Ye Fan thought Shen Murong was talking about protecting her, so he patted his chest: "Don't worry, it's okay!"
Shen Murong looked strange: "Xiao Fan, why can't I understand what you said?"
"It's okay."
Ye Fan shook his head with a smile: "However, I really don't want to be the emperor!"
Shen Murong looked at him: "Oh? Don't you want the rights of one person over ten thousand people?"
Ye Fan shrugged: "How tiring is it to be an emperor? Being imprisoned in the palace for the rest of your life."
"If you really get to that point and support an emperor, wouldn't you be able to control it yourself behind the scenes?"
The eighth sister raised her head in shock, as if she didn't recognize Mark!
…
At the same time, in Daxia Longdu, deep inside a luxurious mansion.
Wang Guozhong, the prime minister of Great Xia, came to a room and knocked on the door seven times. The door opened with a "squeak".
Two stunning girls opened the door and made mute gestures. They were deaf-mute, they couldn't speak or hear, and they couldn't read, so they could keep all the secrets!
After Wang Guozhong made a gesture.
Two deaf-mute girls moved out of the way.
Wang Guozhong walked in and knelt down on one knee in front of a screen: "Your Highness! The emperor is furious and Li Chengqian has been deposed!"
"Ye Fan escaped unscathed, and Shen Murong returned to Longdu!"
A feminine voice came from behind the screen: "I already know!"
Wang Guozhong was secretly surprised. He left the palace immediately and came straight here. His Highness actually knew everything in advance? Could it be that His Majesty also has someone from His Majesty's side?
"Shen Murong came back in a hurry. She was riding a Lightning Falcon. She came back alone!"
